source.title: The Unnamed Spider Bot: Steadywin GIM6010-8, stock controller vs ODrive vs Tinymovr (Hackaday.io log)

unit: GIM6010-8 with the stock driver (ODrive clone, customised 0.5.x firmware)

rig.torqueSensor: Digital load cell on 200 mm arm

notes: A single rough reading: the stall force fluctuated around 55 N at the end of a 200 mm arm at 24 A, about 11 Nm. The same log found that an ODrive Micro (7 A rated) limited stall torque to about 4.8 Nm, which explains a lower 3 Nm figure reported elsewhere.
